metadata.note: Master timeline of all quantum computing milestones relevant to Q-Day.

milestones.event: Peter Shor publishes quantum factoring algorithm
milestones.significance: Theoretical foundation for quantum threat to RSA

milestones.event: First implementation of Shor's algorithm — factors 15
milestones.significance: Proof of concept on 7-qubit NMR computer

milestones.event: Shor's algorithm factors 21 on photonic QC
milestones.significance: Largest quantum factoring to date (still)

milestones.event: IBM Quantum Experience launches — 5 qubits, cloud access
milestones.significance: Quantum computing becomes accessible to researchers

milestones.event: Google Sycamore — 53 qubits, quantum supremacy
milestones.significance: First claim of quantum advantage over classical

milestones.event: RSA-250 (829 bits) factored classically
milestones.significance: Classical factoring record — no quantum involved

milestones.event: IBM Eagle — 127 qubits
milestones.significance: First >100 qubit processor

milestones.event: NIST selects first PQC algorithms (CRYSTALS, FALCON, SPHINCS+)
milestones.significance: Standards selection after 6-year competition

milestones.event: IBM Osprey — 433 qubits
milestones.significance: Rapid physical qubit scaling

milestones.event: Signal deploys PQXDH — first major messenger with PQC
milestones.significance: Consumer PQC deployment begins

milestones.event: Atom Computing — 1,180 qubits (neutral atom)
milestones.significance: Alternative architecture reaches 1000+ qubits

milestones.event: IBM Condor — 1,121 qubits
milestones.significance: Peak physical qubit count (IBM shifts strategy after this)

milestones.event: Apple iMessage deploys PQ3 (ML-KEM)
milestones.significance: Largest consumer PQC deployment by user count

milestones.event: AWS and GCP deploy PQ TLS for cloud services
milestones.significance: Major cloud infrastructure goes PQ

milestones.event: NIST finalizes ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA standards
milestones.significance: Official PQC standards published — YELLOW alert

milestones.event: Cloudflare enables PQ TLS for all customers
milestones.significance: CDN-level PQC — covers millions of websites

milestones.event: Ethereum adds PQC to 'The Splurge' roadmap
milestones.significance: Largest smart contract platform acknowledges threat

milestones.event: DOE Genesis Mission — fault-tolerant by 2028
milestones.significance: US government commits to fault-tolerant quantum — YELLOW alert

milestones.event: Google Willow — below-threshold error correction
milestones.significance: First proof that QEC improves with more qubits — YELLOW alert

milestones.event: Microsoft Majorana 1 — topological qubit chip
milestones.significance: New approach to fault-tolerant qubits, if verified

milestones.event: PsiQuantum Omega — manufacturable photonic chipset (GlobalFoundries Fab 8)
milestones.significance: Million-qubit-scale photonic components ready for semiconductor fab

milestones.event: NIST selects HQC as 5th PQC algorithm (KEM backup to ML-KEM)
milestones.significance: Diversification against future ML-KEM weaknesses

milestones.event: IBM details Starling roadmap — 200 logical qubits / 100M gates by 2029
milestones.significance: First detailed fault-tolerant roadmap with intermediate processors (Loon, Kookaburra, Cockatoo)

milestones.event: First quantum ECDLP — 6-bit elliptic-curve key broken on IBM 133-qubit system
milestones.significance: Project Eleven Q-Day Prize entry (Tippeconnic)

milestones.event: PsiQuantum raises $1B Series E for million-qubit fault-tolerant systems
milestones.significance: Largest single quantum funding round; Brisbane and Chicago sites

milestones.event: Quantinuum Helios — 94 error-detected / 48 error-corrected logical qubits
milestones.significance: Beyond break-even QEC at scale; logical error 10-100x below physical

milestones.event: Quantum sector receives $4.9B VC + $56.7B public funding (2025)
milestones.significance: Private VC more than doubled YoY; quantum approaches 'ChatGPT moment'

milestones.event: Ethereum forms dedicated PQ security team (Thomas Coratger)
milestones.significance: Active engineering investment in blockchain PQC — YELLOW alert

milestones.event: CISA releases Product Categories for PQC-Capable Technologies
milestones.significance: Establishes federal procurement benchmark for PQC availability

milestones.event: BIP-360 (Pay-to-Merkle-Root) proposed for Bitcoin quantum-safe addresses
milestones.significance: First concrete Bitcoin protocol proposal for PQC

milestones.event: Ethereum unveils leanVM + leanXMSS post-quantum architecture (Buterin, ETHDenver)
milestones.significance: EIP-8141 considered for Hegotá hard fork (H2 2026); 250x signature aggregation via zkVM

milestones.event: QuEra demonstrates 96 logical qubits on neutral-atom processor (Nature)
milestones.significance: First >48 verified logical qubits with error-corrected gates simultaneously

milestones.event: Quantinuum accelerates roadmap — universal fault-tolerant QC by 2030
milestones.significance: Industry consensus on fault-tolerance timeline tightens

milestones.event: Meta publishes PQC migration framework (WhatsApp contributors)
milestones.significance: Largest social platform documents enterprise-scale PQC rollout

milestones.event: 15-bit ECDLP broken on ~70-qubit cloud quantum hardware (Project Eleven, Lelli)
milestones.significance: 512x extension of prior public ECDLP record — YELLOW trigger

milestones.event: BIP-361 (Post-Quantum Migration and Legacy Signature Sunset) proposed
milestones.significance: 3-phase Bitcoin migration; would freeze ~6.7M BTC in vulnerable addresses

milestones.event: China unveils Hanyuan-2 — 200-qubit dual-core neutral atom system
milestones.significance: First dual-core neutral atom architecture; benchmarks pending independent verification

milestones.event: Q-CTRL + IBM demonstrate 3,000x speedup on 120-qubit Fermi-Hubbard simulation
milestones.significance: Runtime error suppression unlocks practical quantum advantage
